text:
rachel.sales: FYI - BlueHarbor legal asked for an assurance bundle for their procurement upload: SOC2 excerpt, ISO page, pen-test attestation, and a KMS statement. They also want to run a credentialed scan during the POC. Can we support?
diego.se: Standard pack is OK. Credentialed/ authenticated scans only on dedicated/staging with pre-approval, NDA addendum, and an ops-supervised window. We do not hand over raw scan outputs.
anika.security: Add that any credentialed scan needs a list of test accounts, scope, and they must not create test users that persist. We also require an agreed rate limit.
rachel.sales: They asked if Dedicated includes this in price.
diego.se: Standard evidence pack included; supervised auth scans and legal redlines billed as SOW (estimate starts $6k).
ops-bot: Presigned upload ready when ops provision gives recipient list.
rachel.sales: Draft checklist to send to customer: 
```
- SOC 2 Type II: cover/excerpt PDF
- ISO 27001: certificate page + scope statement
- Pen-test attestation: signed letter + 1p summary
- KMS & encryption controls one-pager
- Pre-scan checklist for credentialed scans (test accounts, IPs, window, scope)
- Upload via presigned S3 (or SFTP on request)
- Contact: rachel.sales for SOW quote
```
anika.security: Sounds good. I will prepare the attestation language.
rachel.sales: Sending now.
